<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents the result of validating a domain literal, providing details about the domain address and domain name.

Description: 
Created to store the outcome of domain validation, this class is instantiated when a domain literal is validated. It is used by the validation service to provide detailed information about the validation result, including the domain address and the domain name.

Attributes:
    domain_address (ipaddress.IPv4Address | ipaddress.IPv6Address): The validated IP address of the domain, set during validation.
    domain (str): The domain name, set during validation.
</DOCSTRING>
